description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Rates' within the PhpSpreadsheet project, specifically for calculating financial security rates such as discount and interest rates. The class includes methods to compute discount rates and interest rates for securities based on various date and value inputs, and utilizes external validation and calculation functions from the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Rates
classes.description: A class providing static methods to calculate financial security rates such as discount rate and interest rate based on settlement, maturity, price, redemption, and basis for [PhpSpreadsheet](https://github.com/PHPOffice/PhpSpreadsheet).

methods.name: discount
methods.description: Calculates the discount rate for a security given settlement date, maturity date, price, redemption value, and basis.

methods.name: interest
methods.description: Calculates the interest rate for a fully invested security given settlement date, maturity date, investment amount, redemption amount, and basis.
